knowledge_misuse: KR-ISO-002 (hard constraint, human review): the agent compared the isolator PACKAGE creepage (8 mm over mold compound with the package's own CTI) against a laminate-based requirement (CTI 175, group IIIa) and used the 480 V temporary overvoltage as the working voltage, whereas the standards agent uses 440 V DC and the printed-wiring-board column (5.5 mm) of IEC 61800-5-1 Table 10 / IEC 60664-1 Table F.4. The item is correctly left to human review, but the stated '~10 mm required' should be presented as one (conservative) interpretation, and the PCB-surface path under the body (laminate) distinguished from the package body.

KR-CAP-001: marked not-applicable, yet its ripple-charge method was used to generate the agent's own 60 uF / 40 uF assumptions although the capacitor agent's result (48.7 uF / 132 uF plus its own bleeders) was available in the same research folder; pre-charge, discharge and bleeder numbers are therefore stale and the bleeders are duplicated.

KR-TH-003 (human-review requirement): applied correctly in spirit (heatsink temperature only, isolation, potentiometer calibration), but concrete OTP/warning thresholds (95 / 85 degC) were fixed without the thermal model; they conflict with the thermal agent's 88-93 degC steady-state sink temperature and its 90 / 100 / 110 degC ladder. The thresholds should have been expressed as a dependency on thermal.json rather than as values.

SPRS439Q absolute-maximum note 3 was paraphrased with an added, incorrect '3.0 V absolute maximum' for the analog inputs; the datasheet states a +-2 mA continuous clamp current with clamping a diode drop above VDDA2 (abs max 4.6 V).

CB-SN-004 / SBOSAG0E: the OC response '100-250 ns' and threshold error '+-2 % typ / +-10 % max' are cited as datasheet values but could not be located in the datasheet text layer in this run; they should carry 'unverified' until the specification table rows are quoted.

KR-SN-005 rationale is applied to the inductor-current path only; the agent correctly states that shoot-through is invisible to the Hall sensor, so KR-PR-001 compliance rests entirely on the gate-driver DESAT (owner correctly identified, not a misuse, but the OC sensor must not be described as the switch-level protection).

Adopt the capacitor agent's values C_in = 48.7 uF effective (36 uF min film) and C_out = 132 uF (108 uF min) and re-issue: pre-charge tau 5.8 ms (4.4-7.3 ms), t99 27 ms (20-34 ms), E 4.7 / 5.6 J, dT_PTC 2.7 K; output discharge 54.8 s from 240 V with 300 k alone. Merge to one bleeder set with the capacitor agent (recommend keeping its 3 x 120 k / 2 x 100 k 2512 strings and adding only the 3-resistor LED indicator string here); otherwise standby loss rises to about 1.4 W at the input.

Temperature supervision: adopt the thermal agent's thresholds (90 degC derate/warn, 100 degC firmware trip, 110 degC hardware trip) or justify a deviation against its 88.2 degC typical / 93 degC max-R steady-state sink temperature; with the agent's bias network these map to V_T = 2.267 / 2.352 / 2.418 V. Make the hardware OTP comparator ratiometric to the APWM pull-up rail (derive its threshold divider from the same 3.3 V rail rather than from REF3125) or implement the OTP trip from the eCAP duty; add the +-1.5 % APWM duty tolerance (+-5.8 K), the 3.3 V rail tolerance (+-5.4 K per +-2 %) and the NTC tolerance (+-1.5 K) to the OTP error budget and the calibration plan.

Restate the 110 % overload peak at the L_min / V_in,max corner: 32.5 A with the design-basis 220 uH (31.85 A with the selected choke's 251 uH minimum) versus the 33.7 A worst-case lower OC bound - margin 1.2-1.9 A before sensor sensitivity/offset error; keep I_OC = 37.5 A but show this margin explicitly. Reword the magnetics open issue for a soft-saturating High Flux core (L about 205-210 uH at 42 A, di/dt 2.1 A/us, overshoot 1.14 A, peak 42.4 A) instead of a hard saturation limit.

Fuse: evaluate the 320 V UVLO-stop corner (15.9 A continuous = 80 %, 17.5 A at 110 % = 88 % of 20 A) and apply the Littelfuse ambient derating for a 50-60 degC enclosure; either prove the 20 A KLKD rating with the time-current/derating curves or move to the 25 A member (57 % / 62 % at 360 V, 70 % at 320 V / 110 %) and raise the source-current-limit assumption to <= 25 A. Add the fuse I2R loss (about 0.9 W cold at 14.2 A) to the auxiliary loss list.

Reconcile the fault architecture with the controller/interconnect agent: combiner type (wired-OR open-collector node with 4.7 k vs 2 x SN74LV21A AND gates), whether bus UVLO_N and RDY are latched (interconnect) or non-latched run-permits (this agent), the latch clock source (FAULT_RESET vs ARM on GPIO2) and who drives UCC21710 RST/EN (FAULT_N AND DRV_EN vs a GPIO). summary: Core engineering of the sensing/protection area is sound: every calculation was recomputed from the stated inputs and the arithmetic agrees (current scaling, OC divider with 120 k loading, 546 ns trip chain, ladders and resistor stress, filters, 5V_ISO budget and R_pre, NTC/AIN/APWM transfer, comparator thresholds, pre-charge and PTC checks). Key datasheet facts were independently confirmed from freshly downloaded PDFs: TMCS1133C2A 50 mV/A / 0.33 V / -4.6..57.4 A at 3.3 V, Eq. 21 VOC = S x IOC / 2.5, 120 k pin impedance, 3.5 A hysteresis, R_IN 0.7 mOhm, A-suffixed orderables; UCC21710 AIN 0.6-4.5 V, I_AIN 200 uA +-3 %, Eq. 12 duty law, 60 ns deglitch, 130 ns tPD, RST/EN > 1000 ns; Omron G9EA-1 60 A / 400 VDC, 400 V maximum switching voltage, 5 W coil; F28335 TZ1/TZ2/eCAP1 mapping and the +-2 mA clamp note. The result nevertheless needs corrections: (1) the 2 x 220 k LED indicator string exceeds 1206 voltage and power ratings (220 V / 220 mW per resistor at 440 V) contrary to the stated '<= 160 V per element'; (2) the 60 uF / 40 uF capacitance assumptions contradict the capacitor agent's 48.7 uF / 132 uF and its already-specified bleeders (output discharge becomes 55 s, bleeders duplicated); (3) the 85 degC warning / 95 degC OTP conflict with the thermal agent's 88-93 degC full-load sink temperature and its 90/100/110 degC ladder, the NTC part differs between agents, and the OTP comparator is not ratiometric to the APWM rail (+-5 K per 2 % rail error, +-5.8 K duty tolerance omitted); (4) the overload peak was taken at nominal ripple instead of the L_min / V_in,max corner (32.5 A, margin to the worst-case low trip bound 1.2-1.9 A); (5) the fuse analysis omits the 320 V UVLO-stop corner (88 % loading at 110 %) and ambient derating; (6) the relay cannot break load above its 400 V maximum switching voltage, so the 'abnormal-case breaking' claim is invalid over the operating range; (7) the fault-combiner/UVLO-latching architecture conflicts with the interconnect agent's result; (8) the F28335 '3.0 V absolute maximum' premise is wrong. Human-review items (isolator creepage, DESAT coordination, NTC insulation, discharge standard) were surfaced rather than decided, and reference instance values were not copied. Verdict: confirmed with corrections.
